dict.string: Dualion shows and manages the files on your Desktop.
Dualion shows and manages the files in your Documents folder.
Dualion shows and manages the files in your Downloads folder.
Dualion shows and manages files on external drives.
Dualion shows and manages files on network volumes.
Dualion shows and manages the files in iCloud Drive and other cloud storage.
Dualion asks Finder to show the Get Info window.
